notes.title: Achievements... and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27904247/c6cec0f982d17d0e0de1e92e4a2000be3b0d6132.png[/img]

We are extremely happy to announce a rather large update to Oodlescape - The Apocalypse! As you can see above, strange things are happening in the bunker... 

We don't want to give away all the fun, but look below for some hints!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Achievements! Over 20 achievements have been implemented. 
[*] Fun and interesting experiences have been hidden into the game. Experiment with words in the first room and who knows what might happen!
[*] Notes from Thompson's grandmother have appeared in the bunker. I wonder if this has something to do with the recent changes? Hmm...
[*] Visual updates with new graphical models. 

[/list]
Bug Fixes: 
[list]
[*] An issue with the yellow/red lock box combination has been resolved.
[*] Grab and physics improvements to some objects.

[/list]

We hope you like the update! Even if you have already escaped before you may find more to do now!

notes.title: What's the word!? New Update!
notes.content:
There's nothing more frustrating sometimes than thinking you've got things all figured out and then at the very end... nothing. We here at Oodlescube understand your pain. 

We have implemented a new feature specifically for those thinking the AI is playing nasty tricks on them. If you fail to escape the first room in the initial allotment of time given you will now see the correct word displayed beside the door. This provides a level of transparency previously unheard of inside the lab!  

Remember, the word still changes every time you try to escape! Good luck!

notes.title: Update! Version 1.02
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've been hard at work pondering ways to increase productivity in the lab and came up with a few adjustments! 

Altered time mechanics will produce some interesting changes for our employees. This is for your benefit and will ensure you stay nice and awake during your employment! 

Please refrain from firing firearms or pointing sharp objects directly towards your head. If you should decapitate yourself, you will be returned to the lobby and will have to try again!

Changes:
[list]
[*] You can return to the lobby by shooting yourself 10 times in the head. This helps encourage multiple attempts if you get frustrated before the time runs out. Remember, puzzle solutions change and you may have an easier time next time! *Note: this only works with "Bloodless" mode turned off. 
[*] The initial time remaining for the first room has been reduced to 20 minutes to encourage multiple attempts if stuck. Overall game experience is still timed for 45 minutes.
[*] Minor visual updates (some new models) 
[*] Minor bug fixes
